process_issues.description: #685: implementer's d.ts declared unwrapped SDK returns while the hey-api client returns {data,error} envelopes; 27 'as unknown as' casts papered over the mismatch and the c1 contract test asserted a narrower pattern than the criterion. Caught by gate grep vs criterion text; repaired (envelope types, zero casts, strengthened c1).

#686: implementer persisted parts from event.properties.parts on message.updated — a field that does not exist in v1.14.49 (UpdatedEventSchema = {sessionID, info}); the fixture invented the field so 13/13 tests were false-green while production parts_json would never populate. Caught by gate cross-checking the fixture against /tmp/opencode message-v2.ts; repaired (part-event accumulation + fixture-honesty guard test).

#689: getSession returned null on ANY error including thrown transport failures, conflating engine hiccups with session-gone — resume() would 410 and offer 'start fresh' against a live conversation. Caught by gate convention review (#685 no-silent-defaults); repaired in-process with discrimination + regression tests.

AgentFlow implement_issue unusable for implementation phases: runtime hardcodes maxTurns=10 for tool-using agents (agent-sdk-executor.js:34); implementer died with error_max_turns in 43s. Fell back to SKILL.md chain (Agent-tool coding agents + in-session gates) per documented routing rule. Fix chip filed for the agentflow repo (task_907eeae6).

expected_chain: per issue x5: acceptance-contract -> coding-agent -> verification-gate -> (failure-triage -> repair -> re-gate)
PR open with Closes lines + CI gate

#686: coding-agent 13 tests green; gate caught invented event field via source ground-truth -> failure-triage Skill -> repair agent (17 real-sequence tests) -> re-gate PASS (659b0f7)

notes: Three of five issues had defects that green test suites did not catch and the gate did — all three were variants of asserting invented shapes instead of ground truth. The /tmp/opencode pinned clone (exact embedded SDK version) was the load-bearing verification asset; keep it (or re-clone at the pinned tag) for M2-M4 gates. Manual smoke for M1 is pending user (visual deferral + behavioral resume/reconnect checks).
